filter-column-age-hint: Ha mazgabaa gelidosappe ha gallassaa qoodappe aadhdhida kaardeta qotta. Hara mazgabatinne gelida gallassai erettibeenna kaardeti be’ettishe de’ana. Kaardiyaa laammiyogee mazgabaa giddon de’ida wodiyaa naa’anta doommissenna.
filter-on-desc: Neeni ha bookkiya bolla kaardiyata piltterissaasa. Piltteriyaa laammanaw hagaa qoxxa.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Kaardetu gallassata @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt woykko @listEnteredAt go’ettidi shaakka. Leemisuwa: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' woykko @endAt = none. @-n doommiya ne medhdhida saaxiniyaa sunttaa issi asa qaalaa akkiyo malaatatu giddon wotta.
advanced-filter-description: Aattiya piltteriyay ha oottissiya malaatata oykkiya xaafuwaa xaafanaw maatees: == != <= >= && || ( ) Oottissiya malaatata giddon shaakkanaw mela sohoy go'ettees. Dumma saaxinetuwaa ubbaa eta sunttatanne woraqata xaafada piltterissana danddayaasa. Leemisuwaas: Field1 == Value1. Hassayissa: Saaxinetuwaa woykko woraqata giddon mela sohoy de'iko, issi qofaa malaatata ('') giddo gelissana bessees. Leemisuwaas: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Issi oottissiya malaatati (' \/) aadhdhanaw, \ go'ettana danddayaasa. Leemisuwaas: Field1 == I\'m. Qassi daro hanotata issife gattana danddayaasa. Leemisuwaas: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ubba wode oottissiya malaatati haddirssaappe ushachchaa nabbabettoosona. Gaxaa malaatata wottada maaraa laammana danddayaasa. Leemisuwaas: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Qassi xaafuwaa saaxinetuwaa regex-n koyyana danddayaasa: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Kaardiyay medhettiya wode, woy huucettay woy birshechchay laamettiya wodenne ooratha qaalay hessa oyqqiko gigees (dalgga woy guutha pilggetu giddon dummatethi baawa).
imported-member-no-account: Gelettida yaraa — haray gaittiya akkawuntiyay baawa
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Kanboard kessido JSON qaachi wotta: "columns" (woykko column_name oykkiya tasks) qassi "tasks" shiishshuwaa (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags) de'iya miishshaa. Columns mazgabata gidoosona qassi tasks kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-deck: NextCloud Deck bookkiya JSON qaachi wotta ("stacks" de'iya bookkiya, stack ubbay ba "cards" oykkees). Stacks mazgabata gidoosona qassi cards kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-openproject: OpenProject work-packages shiishshuwaa JSON qaachi wotta (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Hanotati mazgabata gidoosona qassi work packages kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-issues: __sourceName__ issues JSON shiishshuwaa qaachi wotta (__endpoint__). Issues Dooyettida / Gordettida mazgabatun shaakettida kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-asana: Asana tasks kessido JSON qaachi wotta (Asana kessiyoogaappe woykko GET /tasks-ppe { "data": [...] }). Oosoti kifiletun (memberships) shaakettoosona; polettida oosoti Done-kko boosona.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: ZenKit mazgabaa kessido JSON qaachi wotta ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages mazgabata gidoosona qassi items kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Markdoone ooso xaafo doorssaa akayaa (Obsidian Kanban mala markdown-kanban miishati go'ettiyo wogaa): garssan "- [ ]"/"- [x]" mishatinne "## Doorssaa sunthaa" huucettaa. Huucettati doorssa gidoosonanne mishati kaardde gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-leo: Leo giigissuwaa (.leo fayiliya) haagan shiisha. Ubbaappe bolla baggan de'iya shaahoti mazgabetu gidoosona; eta garsan sutsa de'iya shaahoti kaarddetu gidoosona, shaahuwaa xaafuu kaardiyaa qonccissuwaa gidees. Gujjiidi ciimma baggan de'iya shaahoti paccissiya mazgabetu gidoosona. Malaatati de'iyo shaahoti polettidaageetu mala giddo geloosona.
import-board-instruction-opml: Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq qassi hara outliner-ti kessiyo mala OPML outline wotta. Bollaa miishshati mazgabata gidoosona, eta naati qofaa qonccissuwaa oothidi kaardiyata gidoosona, qassi garssaa miishshati paacciya mazgabata gidoosona. Wurssettida miishshati wurssettidaagaa gidi gelettoosona.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Emacs, Orgzly woykko Beorg xaafiyo mala Org mode fayliyaa wotta. Bollaa huuphe sunttati mazgabata gidoosona qassi naa'anttoo huuphe sunttati kaardiyata gidoosona. TODO qassi DONE, koyrotethaa, malaatata, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE qassi CLOSED naagettoosona, qassi paacciya saaxinetuwaynne garssaa huuphe sunttati paacciya mazgabata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: todo.txt fayliyaa shiisha: issi xiqiyan issi oosuwaa, todo.txt appiine aara gaitti oottiya appeti xaafiyoogaadan. Polettida oosoti ("x") "Polettiis" baggaa boosona, +project nna @context malaata gidoosona, (A) kase oottiyoogaa malaata gidees, due: nna t: wurssiyo gallassaanne doommiya gallassaa gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: task export kessidoogaa qaachi wotta: JSON shiishshuwaa, woykko haariya ubban issi oosuwaa. Polettida oosoti Done-kko bees; project-ne priority malaatata gidees; annotations qofata gidees; depends hara oosoti oykkiyo gathetettata gidees.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: .boardarchive faayiliyaa birsha; bookkiyaa board.jsonl qaachi wotta, a nusukaa haariyara woykko he haariyay baynnan. Bookkiyaa bessiyoosan waati shiishshanakkonne doorissiya meretay mazgabata gidees; hara dooriyo meretati malaatata gidoosona; xaafoonne malaataa wottiyo saaxinetu kifleti qonccissuwaanne paccissiya mazgabaa gidoosona; qofati naagettoosona. Misiletinne gattidobati gelikkona.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: MeisterTask-n, projektiyaa sunttaa qoxxa, Export project doorada CSV kessa, yaatin wotta. Kifiliyati mazgabata gidoosona qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta qofaara, wurssetta gallassaara, oosoy imettidoogaaranne malaatataara; wurssettida oosoti eta wurssettida gallassaa naagoosona. MeisterTask-a huuphe gelissuwaas xaafettida CSV-ykka oottees.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Obsidian-n, Kanban bookkiya fayliyaa Markdown gidi dooya (woykko .md fayliyaa xaafiyo programiyan dooya), yaatin ubbaa wotta. Ogeti eta kaardiyaa qoodaara mazgabata gidoosona, kaardiyati eta malaatata, gallassata, koyrotethaa, saaxinetuwaanne paacciya mazgabaa naagoosona, qassi Archive naago sohuwaa efettida kaardiyata gidees.
import-board-instruction-linear: Linear-n, oyshata CSV gidi kessa (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, woykko xeelluwaa kessuwaa), yaatin CSV wotta. Hanotati mazgabata gidoosona, kifiliyati ogeta gidoosona, qassi oyshati kaardiyata gidoosona, oosoy imettidoogaara, malaatataara, gallassataara, aawaa oyshaara, koyrotethaara, qoodaara, projektiyaaranne yuuyuwaara.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: TickTick-n, Settings, Account, Backup & Import dooyada backup medha, yaatin CSV fayliyaa wotta. TickTick mazgabay ubbay ogiya gidees qassi a tuussati mazgabata gidoosona; oosoti eta malaatata, gallassata, paacciya mazgabaa, koyrotethaanne guutta oosuwaa naagoosona.
import-board-instruction-clickup: ClickUp-n, oosota CSV gidi kessa (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, woykko tuussati ubbay de'iya List woykko Table xeelluwaa kessuwaa), yaatin CSV wotta. Hanotati mazgabata gidoosona, ClickUp mazgabati ogeta gidoosona, qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta guutta oosuwaara, oosoy imettidoogeetaara, malaatataara, gallassataara, koyrotethaaranne wodiyaara.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Nullboard-n, bookkiya dooya, menuwaappe Export this board... doora, .nbx fayliyaa xaafiyo programiyan dooyada a giddon de'iyaagaa wotta. Mazgabati mazgabata gidoosona qassi qofati kaardiyata gidoosona: qofaa koyro xuuraa kaardiya sunttaa, attidaagee a qonccissuwaa. Gidenna qofay raw giya malaataa ekkees. Daro bookkiyati de'iya fayliyaappe koyro bookkiyaa xalaala gelettees.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Kanri-n, Import & Export dooyada Export individual board (woykko Export all data) doora, yaatin .json fayliyaa wotta. Tuussati mazgabata gidoosona qassi kaardiyati kaardiyata gidoosona, eta qonccissuwaara, wurssetta gallassaara, malaatataaranne merataara; kaardiyaa oosoti paacciya mazgabaa gidoosona. Ubba data kessuwaappe koyro bookkiyay gelettees.
import-board-instruction-planka: Ne Planka ketaa (leemisuwau https://planka.example.com), ne Planka oosanchchaa sunttaanne geeman qaalaa xaafa, yaatidi "Mazgabaa bessa" xiqqa. Eti bookkiyaa ekkanau xalaala goettettoosona; naagettokkona. Bookkiyaa doorada "Ekka" xiqqa: WeKan Planka API-ppe bookkiyaa mazgabaatuwaara, kaardiyaatuwaara, qonccissuwaara, wurssiya gallassatuwaara, malaatatuwaara, miishshatuwaara, oosuwaa mazgabaatuwaaranne qofatuwaara nabbabees; yaatidi gelissuwaa ubbatoo mala ayfiya. Planka naago sohuwan de7iya kaardiyaati naagettidaagaadan gelettoosona; gaytettida faylliyaatinne olliyaa qumbbuwan de7iya kaardiyaati gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer) giddon gela, Tasks.Read paqadiyaa ma77a, qassi Access token sohuwaappe tookeniyaa shiishsha. Hayssan wotta, "Mazgabaa bessa" xiqqa; tookeniyaa ha ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna. Mazgabaa ubbaa woykko issi mazgabaa doorada "Ekka" xiqqa. To Do mazgabaa ubbay mazgabaa, oosuwaa ubbay kaardiyaa gidees, qofaara, wurssiyaanne doommiya gallassaara, denddaati paccissiya mazgabaa, shaakkuwaati malaata, darotoo keehaanne de7uwaa malaata gidiyaagaara; wurssida oosoti naagettoosona. Hassayissuwaatinne zaarettuwaati gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: KanbanFlow giddon bookkiyaa menuwaa doya, Settings → API & Webhooks doorada bookkiyaa API tookeniyaa shiishsha. Tookeniyaa hayssan wotta, "Mazgabaa bessa" xiqqa, bookkiyaa doorada "Ekka" xiqqa; tookeniyaa he ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna. Xeetati mazgabaa gidoosona, ogeti ogiya gididi attoosona; oosoti bantta qonccissuwaa, halluwaa, malaataa, wurssiya gallassaa, guutta oosota paccissiya mazgabaa gidiyaagaadan, aattida wodiyaa, qiyaasuwaa, asaanne qofaa naagoosona.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Ne Basecamp akaawuntiyaa ID (ketaa giddon basecamp.com/ simmin de7iya qoodaa) qassi geliya tookeniyaa (launchpad.37signals.com bolli xaafettida OAuth 2 app-ppe, woykko de7iya gaytuwaa kasetidi de7iyaagaa) xaafa, "Mazgabaa bessa" xiqqa, proojektiyaa doorada "Ekka" xiqqa. Tookeniyaa he ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna. Kaardiyaa shaaxaa ubbay bantta xeetaa mazgabaa oottidi ogiya gidees, qassi oottana bessiyaabaa mazgabaati "To-dos" ogiya gidoosona; kaardiyaatinne oottana bessiyaabati xuufiyaa, gallassaa, immettidaageetanne qofaa naagoosona, kaardiyaa denddaati paccissiya mazgabaa gidoosona, wurssidaageeti naagettoosona.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: OAuth 2.0 Playground-ppe geliya tookeniyaa ekka: Tasks API v1 garsan tasks.readonly doora, Authorize APIs xiqqa, yaatidi Exchange authorization code for tokens, qassi access token shiishsha. Hayssan wotta "Mazgabaa bessa" xiqqa, oosuwaa mazgabaa ubbaa woykko issuwaa doora, yaatidi "Ekka". Tookeniyaa ha ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna. Oosuwaa mazgabaati mazgabaa, oosoti kaardiyaa gidoosona, qofaara, gaytiyaabaaranne wurssiya gallassaara; guutta oosoti paccissiya mazgabaa gidoosona, wurssida oosoti naagettidaagaadan gelettoosona.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: Google Keep API Google Workspace akaawuntiyaa xalaalaassa. https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly scope de7iya OAuth 2.0 geliya tookeniyaa ekka (ne Workspace aawai paqadiyaabaa gidikko OAuth 2.0 Playground giddon, woykko domeniyaa ubbaa maataa de7iya oosuwaa akaawuntiyaappe), wotta, "Mazgabaa bessa" yaatidi "Ekka" xiqqa. Tookeniyaa ha ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna. Xuufiyaa qofati "Notes" mazgabaa giddon kaardiyaa gidoosona, qassi paccissiya mazgabaa qofati "Lists" mazgabaa giddon bantta mishshaa paccissiya mazgabaa oottidi kaardiyaa gidoosona. Ollettida qofati, gaytettida faylliyaatinne shaakkuwaa gelettokkona.
api-import-desc: Ne huu7e akaawuntiyaara oosuwaappe ekka. Ne hayssan xaafiyaabay ha ekkuwaa xalaalau goettettees, naagettenna.
api-import-fetched: Ekkettiis. Garsan de7iya miishshata xeellada gelissa.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Pivotal Tracker-n, projektiyaa MORE tab dooyada Export CSV doora (woykko taarikata doorada Bulk Actions, CSV doora), yaatin CSV wotta. Taarikaa hanotay ubbay mazgabaa gidees qassi taarikati kaardiyata gidoosona, eta dummataranne malaatataara, aawatuuranne, oychchidaagaara, gallassataara, qofataara, oosotaranne diggiyaageetaara; Estimate Story points gidees qassi yuuyoti sprint-ta gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Tasks.org-n, Settings, Backups dooyada Export tasks doora, yaatin he .json fayliyaa giddon de'iyaagaa wotta. Mazgabati mazgabata gidoosona qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta qofaara, malaatataara, gallassataara, qofataaranne guutta oosuwaara; wurssettida oosoti eta wurssettida gallassaa naagoosona, qassi koyrotethay dumma saaxiniyaa gidees.
import-board-instruction-monday: monday.com-n, bookkiya menuwaa dooyada More actions qassi Export board to Excel doora (koyikko updates and subitems-ara), yaatin he .xlsx fayliyaa doora. Status tuussay mazgabata gidees qassi citati ogeta gidoosona; asati, gallassati, wodee intenne malaatati eta sohuwaa naagoosona, hara tuussati dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona qassi updates qofata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Super Productivity-n, Settings dooya, yaatin Sync & Backup, Export Data doorada sp-backup .json fayliyaa giddon de'iyaagaa wotta. Projektiyay ubbay ogiya gidees qassi oosoti To Do, In Progress, Backlog woykko Done giddon kaardiyata gidoosona, eta qofaara, malaatataara, wurssetta gallassaara, aadhdhida wodiyaaranne guutta oosuwaara; naago sohuwaa efettida oosoti naago sohuwaa efettida kaardiyata gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Taiga-n, Admin > Project > Export dooyada projektiyaa dump ehha (koyro .json.gz fayliyaa birshsha), yaatin a JSON wotta. User story hanotati mazgabata gidoosona, user story-ti eta oosuwaa guutta oosuwaa oothidi kaardiyata gidoosona, epic-tinne oyshati eta huuphe ogeta ekkoosona, qassi sprint-ti, malaatati, qofatinne dumma sohuwati yaana. Gattidobati gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Vikunja-n, Settings dooyada Data Export doora qassi neessi kiittiyo .zip fayliyaa ehha, yaatin he fayliyaa doora, woykko a giddon de'iya data.json wotta. Kanban bucket-ti mazgabata gidoosona qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta malaatataara, oosoy imettidoogeetaara, gallassataara, qonccissuwaara, paacciya mazgabata gidida oosuwaa mazgabataranne qofataara; koyrotethay, wurssettida xeetaa qoodaynne wurssettidaagee dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona. Gattidobati gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-quire: Quire-n, projektiyaa menuwaa dooyada Export CSV doora, yaatin CSV wotta. Hanotati mazgabata gidoosona qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta guutta oosuwaa naa kaardiyata oothidi, oosoy imettidoogeetaara, malaata gidida tag-taara, doommiya, wurssetta qassi wurssettida gallassataara, qonccissuwaaranne dumma saaxiniyaa gidida koyrotethaara. Qofatinne gattidobati Quire-a CSV giddon baawa.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Wrike-n, projektiyaa woykko folderiyaa Excel-a kessa, woykko Wrike-a Excel gelissiyo leemisuwaa kunttha, yaatin he .xlsx fayliyaa doora. Folderiyaanne projektiyaa xuurati ogeta gidoosona, Status mazgabata gidees qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona, eta Key-ara, aawaa oosuwaara, oosoy imettidoogeetaara, doommiyaanne wurssiya gallassataara, gaittotaranne qonccissuwaara; Priority, Duration qassi hara tuussati dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Teamwork.com-n, Excel oosuwaa gelissiyo leemisuwaa kunttha (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) qassi .xlsx gidi naaga, yaatin he fayliyaa doora. Oosuwaa mazgabati mazgabata gidoosona qassi oosoti kaardiyata gidoosona; -, # woykko > n doommiya oosoy a bollan de'iya oosuwaa guutta oosuwaa gidees (--, ## woykko >> issi deriyaa garssa). Oosoy imettidoogeeti, gallassatinne malaatati eta sohuwaa naagoosona; Priority, Estimated time qassi Complete dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Businessmap-n (kasekoo Kanbanize), Advanced Search dooyada tuussata doorana mala Configure results doora, Excel fayliyaa ehha, yaatin he .xlsx fayliyaa doora. Tuussati eta Engliizetta sunttaan nabbabettoosona (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): ne akkawuntiyay hara qaalaa go'ettiyaakko, koyro huuphe xuuraa Engliizetta sunttan laamma. Column mazgabata qassi Lane ogeta gidoosona; aawati, malaatati, meray, gallassati, qofatinne aawaa gattati eta sohuwaa naagoosona, qassi Priority, Size, Type qassi hara tuussati dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Redmine-n, projektiyaa Issues dooya, mazgabaa garssan Also available in: CSV doora, tuussata doora (All columns, Description-ara) qassi kessa, yaatin CSV wotta. Redmine tuussata ne qaalan sunttees, hiza kessanaappe kase My account giddon ne qaalaa Engliizetta ootta. Hanotay ubbay mazgabaa gidees qassi oyshati kaardiyata gidoosona, tracker malaataa oothidi, oosoy imettidoogaara, xaafidaagaara, gallassataara, aawaa oosuwaaranne gaittida oyshataara; koyrotethay, dummay, halchchida versioniyaa, qoodettida wodee, % Done qassi dumma saaxinetuwati dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona.
import-board-instruction-notion: Notion-n, daatabeeziyaa kumetta sinttaa gidi dooya, ••• qassi Export doora, Markdown & CSV doora, qassi a ehhiyo .zip fayliyaa doora, woykko a giddoppe issi daatabeeziyaa CSV, woykko he CSV wotta. Status giya tuussay mazgabata gidees (baynnaba, select mala be'ettiya koyro tuussay gidees, qassi gelissuwaa erissuwaa aybee gidiyaakko yootees); xuurati eta sunttaara, malaata gidida tag-taara, yaara gidida asataara, gallassataara qassi qonccissuwaa gidida sinttaa xaafaara kaardiyata gidoosona; hara tuussati dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona. Gaittoti, misiliyatinne gattidobati gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-plane: Plane-n, Workspace Settings dooyada Exports doora, projektiyata JSON, CSV woykko Excel gidi kessada .zip fayliyaa ehha, yaatin he fayliyaa doora, woykko a giddoppe issi fayliyaa, woykko JSON woykko CSV wotta. Hanotati mazgabata gidoosona, projektiyati ogeta gidoosona, qassi oyshati kaardiyata gidoosona, eta erettiyo malaataara, aawaara, oosoy imettidoogeetaara, malaatataara, gallassataara, gattataaranne qofataara; koyrotethay, qoodaa, yuuyoynne moduliyay dumma saaxinetuwaa gidoosona. Plane-a kessuwan qonccissuwaynne gattidobay baawa, hiza gelettokkona.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ne Trello bookkiyan 'Menu', yaappe 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON' baggaa baada, kessido xaafuwaa dammissa.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ne komaan shaakettida woraqata (CSV)/ Tab-n shaakettida woraqata (TSV) qaachi wotta .
import-board-instruction-jira: Jira Cloud issue koyiyoogaa JSON qaachi wotta: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (fields bayinnan issue ids xalaala zaarees). Gita oosoy sinttatun yees, sinttaa ubbay kaalliya sinttaas nextPageToken oykkees: sinttata ubbaa issues issi "issues" shiishshuwaa giddo wotta, woykko sinttaa ubbaa Daro bookkiyata gelissa go'ettada ba bookkiya oottada gelissa. Issi mala { "issues": [...] } miishshaykka oottees. Jira hanotati mazgabata gidoosona qassi issues kaardiyata gidoosona. Seerata gelissanaw, koyikko "automationRules" shiishshuwaa gujja.
import-board-instruction-excel: .xlsx workbook doora: issi xuraan issi kaardiya de'iya shaahuwaa (Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, gallassatanne dumma saaxinetuwaa mala columns), woykko WeKan kessido workbook, bookkiya ubbay ba sinttan de'iyaagaakka. Kaalliya ogee ay column ay saaxiniyaa gidiyaakko bessees. Huuphiyaa xuraa de'iya sinttay ubbay bookkiya gidees.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ne bookkiyan 'Menu', yaappe 'Export board' baggaa baada, duge ekkido faayiliyan de'iya xaafuwaa dammissa.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - *<n>* gallassaappe kase woykko guuxxa wode kase medhettida kaardiyaata

globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - naago sohuwaa efettidaanne efettibeenna kaardiyaata ubbaa
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - asa ubbaassi bookkiyaatun xalla de'iya kaardiyaata
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - *<field>* hayssatuppe issuwaa: `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` woykko `__predicate_member__`. *<field>* sinttan `-` wottiyoogee he saaxiniyan wagay baynnaageeta koyees (leemisuwas `has:-due` wurssiyo gallassay baynna kaardiyaata koyees).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - *<sort-name>* hayssatuppe issuwaa: `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` woykko `__predicate_modified__`. Gitaappe guuxxaakko maaranaw, maaraa sunttaa sinttan `-` wotta.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - *<n>* issi sinttan bessettana koshshiya kaardiyaata qoodaa erissiya loo'o kumetta qoodaa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Issi mala oottiyaabati *WOYKKO* gididi gaittettoosona. Hanotatuppe issuwaara gaittiya kaardiyaati simmettoosona.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` *Blocked* woykko *Available* giya sunttay de'iya ay mazgabaa giddon de'iya kaardiyaata simmissees.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Dumma dumma oottiyaabati *QASSI* gididi gaittettoosona. Dumma oottiyaabata ubbaara gaittiya kaardiyaati xalla simmettoosona. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` *zo'o* malaatay de'iya *Available* mazgabaa giddon de'iya kaardiyaata xalla simmissees.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Gallassati loo'o woykko iitta kumetta qoodan woykko ha77i wodiyaas `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` woykko `__predicate_year__` go'ettidi erissettana danddayoosona.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Xaafuwaa koyiyoogee gita woykko guutha birshshettaa dummayissenna.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Gishetan naago sohuwaa efettida kaardiyaati koyettokkona.

database-migration-description: Xaafuwaa daataa (gattidobatanne avataara misileta attin ubbaa; eti fayliyaa maaran attoosona) MongoDB-nne FerretDB v1 (SQLite) giddon sirssa. Hara daatabeeziyaa oosettiya qassi gakkanau danddayettiya gidana koshshees (kase giigettida poorteta: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL-n laamma). Polettidaappe guyyiyan, MONGO_URL hara daatabeeziyaa bessanaadan oottada WeKan zaarettada doomissa (Snap bolla: snap set wekan database=ferretdb woykko =mongodb).
database-migration-confirm: Xaafuwaa shiishshuwata ubbaa __db__-kko dammissanee? Fayliyaa maaran de'iya gattidobatanne avataara misileta aybikka gakkenna. Biyo daatabeeziyaa oosettiya gidana koshshees.
sandstorm-migration-description: WeKan Sandstorm grain-iyaa giddon oosettiyo wode, a kase MongoDB 3 daatabeezee koyro doommiyo wode FerretDB v1-kko (SQLite) sirssettees, qassi gattidobatinne avataara misileti daatabeeziyaappe grain-iyaa files/attachments-nne files/avatars sohotakko laammettoosona. Hayssi he sirssuwaa attamidaakko, qassi kase MongoDB daatabeeziyaa fayleti grain-iyaa giddon disikiyaa sohuwaa ayyaa oottiyaakko bessees; mela sohuwaa demmanaw he fayleta xayssanau danddayissees.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Sirssuwaa attamidaappe guyyiyan daatay FerretDB-nne fayliyaa maaran de'ees; hiza grain disikiyaa sohuwaa melissanaw kase MongoDB 3 daatabeeziyaa fayleta xayssanau danddayettees. Hayssa zaarissanau danddayettenna.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Disikiyaa sohuwaa melissanaw kase MongoDB 3 daatabeeziyaa fayleta xayssanee? Daatay kase FerretDB-nne fayliyaa maaraakko sirssettiis. Hayssa zaarissanau danddayettenna.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Kase MongoDB daatabeeziyaa fayleti xayettoosona, melissettiis
features-desc: Ha WeKan immiyo doorana danddayettiya oosota. Malaataa wottibeenna oosoy oosanchchatu ubbaa xeelluwappe qottettees. Aa erissuwaa naagettees; oottana maayettiyo maatay laamettenna.
feature-views-table-desc: Bookkiya kaardiyatu shaahuwaa mala, marataa laammana danddayettiya.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Wodiyaa qoodaa qassi daro bookkiyatu wodiyaa qoodaa.
feature-views-overview-desc: Qoodaa erissuwaa, oosoy imettida asaa baggaara shaakko, ogiyaa giigissuwaa, xeelluwaa bookkiya qassi gita bookkiya.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Medhdhiyo miishshaa attida oosotu mazgabaa, guutta ooso wodiyata, ooso wodiyaa erissuwaa qassi oosuwaa eesotettaa.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Attida oosuwaa guuttatuwaa, polettida oosuwaa darotuwaa, shiiqida oosuwaa hemettaa, doomettosappe polettees gakkanaw wodiyaa qassi oychchettosappe polettees gakkanaw wodiyaa, issi wodiyan polettida oosuwaa qoodaa, pollettibeenna oosuwaa aadhdhida wodiyaa, diggiyabata, Monte Carlo qassi hara oosuwaa hemettaa likkiyabata.
feature-views-map-desc: Kaardiyati de7ana kesettida misiliyaa bolla malaataadan.
feature-approval-required: WeKan ooraxissuwaa baggaara gujjettiya oosota alaafiyaay dooyana gakkanaw gorddidaadan wotta
feature-preview-admins: Alaafiyati gorddida oosota be7oosona, koyro paaccana mala
card-field-visibility-desc: Bookkiyati bessana danddayiya Bookkiya giigissuwaa / Kaardiya saaxinetuwaa. Malaatettibeenna saaxiniyay bookkiya ubbaa kaardiyaappe, guutta kaardiyaappenne Bookkiya giigissuwaa / Kaardiyaappe qotettees. Kaardiyaa daatay woykko bookkiya giigissuway laamettenna, qassi zaarada malaatiyo wode bookkiyay ubbay giigissettida mala bessettees. Saaxinetuwaa maaray bookkiya ubbaa huuphe.
cards-loading-auto: Ba huuphen (gita bookkiyatussi xalla guuttaa guuttaa)
cards-loading-description: WeKan bookkiyaa kaardiyata ba huuphen caanees: gita bookkiyaa (gitatettaa wurssettaappe aadhdhiyaagee) ha77i bessettiya kaardiyata xalla (wurssettay baynna goochuwaa) qassi de'iya qoodaa caanees; hiza eesotees qassi guutha hassayuwaanne neetiwoorkiyaa goees. Guutha bookkiyati kumetta oosuwau kaardiyata ubbaa caanoosona. Giigissiyoobay baawa. Oosissiyaageeti CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto)-nne CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD heeraa laamettiyaabatun hanotaa wolqqan dooranau danddayoosona.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Guuttaa guuttaa kaardiya caaniyoogee paaccettiyaagaa: kaardiyaa qoodiyaabatinne WIP wurssettati tumu; shin Calendar/Table/Gantt xeelluwatinne darggi dooriyoogee ha77i gakkanaw caanettida kaardiyata xalla bessoosona. Hayssa laammidaappe guyyiyan dooyettida bookkiyata zaarettada caana.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Dooyettiyo wode, gattiyaabati ubbay ([label](url) mala markdown gattiyaabatinne <a href> HTML maataa) xaafuwaa sohota ubban (bookkiyaanne kaardiyaa huuphe sunttata, qonccissuwata, qofata, paccissiya mazgabata, hara) qaxxanau danddayettenna leemmo xaafuwaa mala bessettoosona. Hayssi balettissiya gattiyaabata digees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis; hiza gattiyaabati qaxxettoosona.
always-show-code-as-text: Koodiyaa ubbaa ubba wode leemmo xaafuwaa mala bessa
always-show-code-as-text-description: Dooyettiyo wode, xaafuwaa mulekka markdown woykko HTML mala bessettenna: xaafuwaa sohota ubban (bookkiyaanne kaardiyaa huuphe sunttata, qonccissuwata, qofata, paccissiya mazgabata, hara) doomettaa xaafoy ubbay leemmo xaafuwaa mala bessettees. Hayssi qottettida xaafuwaa qonccissees — HTML qofata (<!-- -->), markdown gattiyaabatu biyo sohuwaa, JavaScript-nne hara koodiyaa — hiza koodiyaa ubbay ubba wode bessettees, qaxxettenna, qassi oosettenna. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis; hiza markdown leemmuwan bessettees.
disable-all-import-description: Dooyettiyo wode, gelissiyo oosoti ubbay gorddettoosona: bookkiyaa WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea qassi Forgejo-ppe gelissiyoogee, qassi bookkiyaa dammissiyoogee. Gelissiyo menu dooruwati qottettoosona qassi serveree gelissiyo oychchuwaa ubbaa ixxees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
disable-all-export-description: Dooyettiyo wode, kessiyo oosoti ubbay gorddettoosona: bookkiyaa WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard mala woykko NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo-kko kessiyoogee, qassi issi gattidobaa kessiyoogee. Kessiyo menu dooruwati qottettoosona qassi serveree kessiyo oychchuwaa ubbaa ixxees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
disable-import-avatars-description: Dooyettiyo wode, avataara misileti (oosanchchaa misileti) mulekka gelettokkona. Hayssi WeKan JSON gelissiyoogaa, Trello gelissiyoogaa, qassi gelanaw kareppe asaa erissiyaageetuppe (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2) avataara gaittissiyoogaa oyqqees. Sunttatinne hara daatay gelettees; avataara misileti xalla aggettoosona. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
disable-export-avatars-description: Dooyettiyo wode, bookkiyaa kessiyo wode (WeKan JSON-nne CSV kessiyoogaa) avataara misileti (oosanchchaa misileti) mulekka gujjettokkona. Oosanchchaa sunttatinne hara daatay kessettees; avataara misileti xalla aggettoosona. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
anonymize-import-users-description: Dooyettiyo wode, WeKan JSON bookkiyaa gelissiyoogee gelettida oosanchchaa ubbaa oosanchchaa sunttaa, kumetta sunttaanne koyro birshshettata qoodiya sohuwaa malaatatun (user1, user2, ...) laammees, avataara misiliyaa diggees, qassi gelettida kaardiyaanne qofaa giddon @username xeesuwatanne (requested-by / assigned-by sohotanne) zaarettada xaafees. Doomettaa bookkiyaappe tumu oosanchchaa erettay aybikka naagettenna. "user" giya qaalay gelissiya asaa qaalaa kaallees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
anonymize-export-users-description: Dooyettiyo wode, bookkiyaa kessiyoogee kessettida oosanchchaa ubbaa oosanchchaa sunttaa, kumetta sunttaanne koyro birshshettata qoodiya sohuwaa malaatatun (user1, user2, ...) laammees, avataara misiliyaa diggees, qassi kaardiyaanne qofaa giddon @username xeesuwatanne (requested-by / assigned-by sohotanne) zaarettada xaafees. Kessettida fayliyan tumu oosanchchaa erettay baawa. "user" giya qaalay kessiya asaa qaalaa kaallees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Ha akkawuntiyaa sunttaa qottanaw neeni ammanettiyye? Hayssi oosanchchaa sunttaa, kumetta sunttaanne iimeeliyaa sohuwaa merinau qottettida malaatatun laammees, avataara misiliyaa diggees, qassi gelanaw gorddees. Xayssiyoogaappe dummatada, bookkiyati, kaardiyatinne qofati ba taarikiyaa naagoosona qassi ha akkawuntiyaa sunttay qottettida mala bessoosona. Ha oosuwaa zaarissanau danddayettenna.
disable-activities-description: Dooyettiyo wode, oosuwaa xaafoy mulekka xaafettenna qassi aysakka bessettenna (bookkiyaa kaxa baggaa xeelluwaa qassi kaardiyaa oosuwaa sohuwaa). Oonee aybi oottidaakko taarikee naagettenna. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
disable-notifications-description: Dooyettiyo wode, WeKan oosuwaa aybissakka xeelliyo erissuwaa (app-iyaa giddon, iimeeliyan woykko hara oosuwan) mulekka kiittenna. Oosoti xaafettana danddayoosona (bolla gorddettibeenna gidikko); erissuwati xalla eqqettoosona. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
disable-watch-description: Dooyettiyo wode, xeelliyo oosoy gorddettees — oosanchchati erissuwaa ekkanaw bookkiyata, mazgabata woykko kaardiyata xeellanau danddayokkona, qassi xeelliyo hanotaa laammanaw paacciyoogee ubbay ixettees. Kase giigissuwan gorddettiis.
backup-description: Gattidobata, avataara misileta qassi/woykko daataa (gattidobata woykko avataara misileta gidonna xaafuwaa shiishshuwata ubbaa) naagiyo dammissuwaa ootta. .zip fayliyaa doorettida naagiyo sohuwaakko suure yeddettees — guutha wodiyaa fayliyaa baynnan — backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip mala, YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars qassi /data oyqqiyaagaa. Cloud naagiyo sohoti (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) ba naagiyo sohuwaa giigissuwan wottida ammanettiyo xaafota goettoosona.
backup-scope-description: Instansiyaa ubbaa, woykko issi Dirijjitiyaa. Dirijjitiyaa naagiyo dammissuwaa a bookkiyata qassi eta bolla de'iyabaa ubbaa, he bookkiyatu gattidobata gujjada oyqqees — shin oosanchchaa akkawuntiyatanne instansiyaa giigissuwaa oyqqenna, ayssi eti Dirijjitiyaa ubbaa giddon shaakettoosona. Dirijjitiyaa naagiyo dammissuwaa zaarissiyoogee he Dirijjitiyaa bookkiyatun xalla xaafees.
continuous-backup-description: Paayduwaan, oykettida faayiletan, ayfiso misiletanne mazgabatan hanida laama ubbaa amarda sekondetu giddon issi maappiyan wottees. Hegaa gishshawu, zaari shiishshiyoogee doorido wode ubbaakko zaarana danddayees. Kumetta arkaabeta medhdhiya wode keexettida naagiyo nusukara issippe oottees.
continuous-backup-enabled: Ha oosuwa immiyagan aggenna naagiyo nusukaa oottissa
continuous-backup-target: Wottiyo maappiyaa (kumetta ogiyaa, hara diskkiyan, shaakettida gathuwa sa’an woykko rclone gathetettan)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: SQLite sinttata (issi issi wodiyan laamettida sinttata)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Ha oosuwa immiyagan paayduwaa oottissiya miishshi oottana danddayenna
continuous-backup-key-file: Geeman xaafiyo qulfiyaa faayiliyaa (kumetta ogiyaa, wottiyo sa’aappe kareera; 64 malaatata 0–9 nne A–F, woykko 16 woykko hegaappe dariya malaatati de’iyo geeman qaalaa). Nusukaa naaga: qulfiyaa baynnan naagiyo nusukaa zaari shiishshana danddayettenna.
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: SQLite paayduwaa faayiliyaa (naagiyo nusukaa achchan keexettees; oottishe de’iya faayiliyaa bolla mulekka xaafettenna)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Kaalliya zaari doommiyo wode zaari keexettida SQLite paayduwaa son wotta (a sohuwaa ekettiya kase paayduwaawu naago de’ees)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Doorido nusukaa yeletaa doorido wodiyawu zaari shiishshanaa? Zaari shiishshiyo wode aggenna naagiyo nusukaa oosoy gam’ees.
backup-restore-confirm: Doorettida naagiyo dammissuwaa zaarissanee? Gattidobatinne avataara misileti fayliyaa maaran, daatay daatabeeziyan doorettida hanotaa mala xaafettoosona.
gcs-key-filename-description: Dooruwaa: serveriyaa bolla de'iya oosuwaa akkawuntiyaa JSON qulppiyaa fayliyaa ogee.
gcs-credentials-description: Dooruwaa: oosuwaa akkawuntiyaa JSON qulppiyaa haagan wotta. Qulppiyaa fayliyaa woykko kase giigettida ammanettiyo xaafota goanaw mela agga.
gcs-permissions-note: WeKan oosuwaa akkawuntiyau bakeetiyaa nabbabanaw/xaafanaw paqqadda: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ne bakeetiyaa → Permissions → Grant access. "New principals" giddon oosuwaa akkawuntiyaa iimeeliyaa — ne JSON qulppiyaappe "client_email" giya gatiyaa — wotta, hessafe "Storage Object Admin" giya oosuwaa doorada Save qaxxa.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Ha77i de'iya gatiyaa naaganaw mela agga.
gcs-bucket-description: Fayleta naagiyo Cloud Storage bakeetiyaa sunttaa.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: mela agga (biittaa endpoint-iyaa goees). S3-ra gaittiyaabaa: ne MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces console-ppe Endpoint URL.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ne bakeetiyaa → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → ne bakeetiyaa sunttaa (woykko Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → ne oosanchchaa → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → 'Application running outside AWS' doora → Create access key. 'Access key ID' giidi bessettees.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Access key ID de'iya issi sinttaa; 'Secret access key' qulppiyaa medhiyo wode issi toho xalla bessettees — he wode dammissa (woykko Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → ne akkawuntiyaa → bollan bessettiya sunttaa (qassi Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → ne akkawuntiyaa → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → ne akkawuntiyaa → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → ne akkawuntiyaa → Data storage → Containers → ne oyqqiyaabaa (woykko issibaa medhanaw + Container).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → bollan de'iya pirojektiyaa dooriyaabaa → ne pirojektiyaa ID (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → ne bakeetiyaa sunttaa (woykko issibaa medhanaw Create).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: WeKan serveriyaa bolla wottada ekkida oosuwaa akkawuntiyaa JSON qulppiyaa fayliyaa ogee (garssan medhettiis). Hayssa goa WOYKKO JSON garssan de'iya sohuwan wotta.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → ne oosuwaa akkawuntiyaa → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (fayliyaa wottada ekkees). A giddon de'iyabaa haagan wotta, woykko fayliyaa naagada a ogiyaa bollan wotta.
gridfs-enabled-description: Fayliyaa naagiyo sohuwau MongoDB GridFS goa
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Gattidobatinne avataara misileti bessettanaadan, eta CollectionFS-ppe hara naagiyo sohuwaakko laammissa.
s3-enabled-description: Fayliyaa naagiyo sohuwau AWS S3 woykko MinIO goa
s3-endpoint-description: S3 endpoint URL (leemisuwaas, s3.amazonaws.com woykko minio.example.com)
schedule-board-archive: Bookkiyaa naago sohuwaa efiyoogaa wodiyan giigissa
writable-path-description: Fayliyaa naagiyo sohuwaa doomettaa fayliyaa sohuwaa ogee
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Mazgabaa maaraa, kaardiyaa sohota qassi ogiyaa maaraa gujjada, bookkiyaa daataa tumatettaa kumetta xeellees qassi giigissees.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Naa'ettida mela mazgabata saro xayssees. Kaardiyaa baynna QASSI kaardiyata oyqqiya issi huuphe sunttaa hara mazgabay de'iya mazgabata xalla diggees.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: swimlaneId woykko listId baynna kaardiyatanne mazgabata demmada zaarissees. Dhayida issibati ubbay zaarettada bessettanaadan 'Lost Cards' ogiyaa medhees.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Naago sohuwan de'iya ogeta, mazgabata qassi kaardiyata ubbaa zaarissees. Issibati bessettanaadan baynna swimlaneId woykko listId ubbaa ba huuphen giigissees.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Bookkiyaa maaran baynna woykko moorettida mazgabata demmada giigissees.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Bookkiyaa yaratussi avataara URL-ata tumu naagiyo sohuwaa goanaadan ooraxissees qassi moorettida avataara bessiyaabata giigissees.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Ha bookkiyaa bolla de'iya gattidobaa fayliyaa URL-ata ubbaa tumu naagiyo sohuwaa goanaadan ooraxissees qassi moorettida fayliyaa bessiyaabata giigissees.
migrations-admin-only: Bookkiyaa alaafiyaati xalla sirssuwata oosissanau danddayoosona
migrations-description: Ha bookkiyau daataa tumatettaa xeelliyoogaanne giigissiyoogaa oosissa. Sirssuwaa ubbaa dumma dumma oosissanau danddayettees.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Hayssi bookkiyaa daataa tumatettaa xeellanawunne giigissanaw kumetta sirssuwaa oottees. Hayssi guutha wodiyaa ekkana danddayees. Sinthe boo?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Hayssi koyro shaakettida mazgabata ubbaa ogiyaa ubbaassi dumma mazgabata oottada laammees, hessafe kaardiyata oyqqiya issi huuphe sunttaa naa'ettida mazgabay de'iya mela mazgabata xayssees. Tumuppe koshshenna mela mazgabati xalla diggettoosona. Sinthe boo?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Hayssi 'Lost Cards' ogiyaa medhees qassi swimlaneId woykko listId baynna kaardiyatanne mazgabata ubbaa zaarissees. Hayssi naago sohuwan baynna issibata xalla gakkees. Sinthe boo?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Hayssi naago sohuwan de'iya ogeta, mazgabata qassi kaardiyata UBBAA zaarissada zaarettada bessees. ID-ti baynna issibati ubbay ba huuphen giigettoosona. Hayssa likke zaarissanau danddayettenna. Sinthe boo?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Hayssi bookkiyaa maaran baynna woykko moorettida mazgabata demmada giigissees. Sinthe boo?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Hayssi bookkiyaa yaratussi avataara URL-ata tumu naagiyo sohuwaa goanaadan ooraxissees. Sinthe boo?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Hayssi ha bookkiyaa bolla de'iya gattidobaa fayliyaa URL-ata ubbaa tumu naagiyo sohuwaa goanaadan ooraxissees. Sinthe boo?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Zaarissiyo dhayida ogeti, mazgabati woykko kaardiyati baawa
migration-progress-note: Ne bookkiyaa ooratta maaraakko sirssiyo wode guuttaa naaga...
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Ogiyaa ubbaassi dumma mazgabati de'iyoogaa xeella
conversion-info-text: Ha laammuwaa bookkiyaa ubbaassi issi toho oosettees qassi oosuwaa eesotettaa lo'issees. Bookkiyaa leemmuwan goettanau danddayaasa.
converting-board-description: Lo'o oosuwau bookkiyaa maaraa laammettees. Hayssi guutha wodiyaa ekkana danddayees.
migration-cpu-threshold-description: CPU oosuwaa ha dhibbaa qoodaappe (10-90) aadhdhiyo wode sirssuwaa shempissa
migration-info-text: Daatabeeziyaa sirssuwati issi toho oosettoosona qassi sistemiyaa oosuwaa eesotettaa lo'issoosona. Ne browser-iyaa gorddikkokka, oosoy guyyiyan sinthe bees.
migration-warning-text: Sirssuwaa wode ne browser-iyaa gorddoppa. Oosoy guyyiyan sinthe bees, shin polettanaw daro wodiyaa ekkana danddayees.

problems-in-progress-help: Hayti sirssuwatinne giigissuwati ha77i oosettoosona. Eti polettidi CPU wodhdhanaw gakkanaw, geliyoogee loddo gidana woykko "Must be logged in" woykko "Loading, please wait" yuuyiyaabaa bessana danddayees.

export-card-details: Kaardiyaa qonccissuwaa (kaardiyaa ubbay kaardiyaa kessiyoogan de'iyaagaadan)

import-parts-instruction: Malaatettida baggati xalla gelettoosona. Kessiyo wodekka he dooruwaa goettees.
import-file-label: Kessuwaa fayliyaa doora, woykko a xaafaa garssan wotta:
sum-of-number-fields: Wodhihi bolla bessiya paydo giddo dumma qofa qoodaa woga

twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Ha QR koodiya authenticator app (Google Authenticator woykko Authy mala) go77ettada skanna, hessafe qonccana 6-tayboo koodiya tuma ero gelthada erissa.

list-sync-description: Ha mazgabaa kare tracker-ppe ginssada wottana. Guyera oosoy dakkiqa 15 wode xeellees; ha77i xeellanaw "Ha77i ginssa" go77etta.
drag-to-reorder: Maaruwaa laammanawu goochcha. Pude kiyiyoogaanne duge wodhdhiyoogaa bessiya wonttafetu qulfeti issi tangguwaa qaassees.
board-view-size-cycle-time: Oosuwaa issibaa gitatettaanne doomettaappe polettiyo wodiyaa
map-view-empty: Ha bookkiyan sa'aa misiliya ha''i gakkanaashin baawa. Bookkiyaa alaafiyayn misiliya — keettaa kifiletu misiliya, sa'aa misiliya woy waaddida misiliya — kessidi yeddanawu danddayees; hegaappe guyyiyan kaarddeta a bolla wottanawu danddayettees.
map-view-place-hint: Kaardiya sa'aa misiliya bollan goochcha, woy a doorada hegaappe guyyiyan a wottiyo sohuwaa maawusiyaa qulfiyan doora.
map-view-all-placed: Kaarddeti ubbay sa'aa misiliya bolla de'oosona.
flow-error: Erissuwaa caananau danddayettibeenna. Gatiyata xeellada zaarettada paacca.
flow-note-agingWip: Dooyettida kaardiyata: ha77i de'iya kaafiyaa gelidosappe gallassata. Zo'o xiqiyati a taarikiyaa 85 dhibbaa qooduwaa (ayssi ichchashu de'uwata) aadhdhoosona. Baynna gelido taarikee erettenna.
flow-note-blockerAnalysis: Gaittota taarikee kaafiyaa ubbaassi diggiyaabay doommidoogaanne wurssidoogaa wodiyaa immees. Ceega gattiyaabati erettibeenna doomettata de'ana danddayoosona. Xayettida kaardiyati naagettida taarikiyaa misileta koshshoosona. Issi wode gakkida gaasoti dumma dumma qoodettoosona.
flow-note-monteCarlo: 2,000 paaccuwati kumetta UTC wodiyaa qoodaa gallassata, zeerowa polettida oosuwaa gallassata gujjada, leemisuwau ekkoosona. Gallassati bolla baggaa qoodettidaagaa; qoodati garssa baggaa ammanettidaagaa. Sinttan issi mala polettiyo oosoy de'ana giidi qoodees; ammanettidaagaa gidenna. Ubbaappe gita wurssettay: 3,650 gallassata. Polettidabay baynnaa gidikko qoodettidabay baawa.
flow-note-processBehavior: Doomettaappe polettiyo wodiyaa Start goees, baynnaa gidikko medhettidoogaa goees; End goees, baynnaa gidikko naago sohuwaa efettidoogaa goees. XmR issibatanne kaallidi dummatiyoogaa, giddo qoodaaranne oosuwaa wurssettatura bessees; ayssi naa'u bessiya polettidabati koshshoosona.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: Ha77i de'iya Planning Poker qoodaa woykko issi payduwaa dumma sohuwaa polettida doomettaappe polettiyo wodiyaara gallassan. Baynna qoodatinne bessenna gallassati aggettoosona. Start baynnaa gidikko medhettidoogaa goees; End baynnaa gidikko naago sohuwaa efettidoogaa goees.
time-adjustment-note: Xaafettida saatiyatu laammuwata, ubbaa laammiya asaa baggaara shiishettidaagaa. Hayti dumma oosuwaa wodiyata gidokkona. Zaa'aa gatiyati giigissuwata. Kase xaafettibeenna wodiyaa oonakka immanau danddayettenna.

scrum-releases-select-help: Kaardiyay daro kessuwaa giddon de'ana danddayees. Issuwaappe daroba doorana Ctrl (Mac bolla Cmd) oykka; kaardiyaa kessuwaa ubbaappe diggana eta ubbaa geeshsha.

scrum-report-help: Erissuwati sprint snapshot-ppe qoodaa naagoosona. Erettibeenna qoodati dummatti qoodettoosona; eti zoppa qoodaa gidokkona. Eesotethaa gaittiya qoodaa mazanaaranne seerataara xalaala geeddarssa.
scrum-confirm-close: Ha sprint gorddada a ayfiyaa naagane? Wurssettibeenna kaardiyati doorettida sohuwaa sirssettoosona.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Ha sprint aggane? A kaardiyati zaarada immettana gakkanaw eta yaratethaa naagoosona.
scrum-partial-report: Bagaa erissuwaa: ha'i neessi immettida kaardiyata xalaala gujjettidosona.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Ha sprint-ay koyro snapshot-a bagaa xalaala de'ees.
scrum-history-job-running: Wogga laamiya guyyawu zaariyoogaa woykko zaari oottiyoogaa: taarikiya xuruureta __total__ giddoppe __done__

scrum-daily-observations-help: Xuuray ubbay UTC gallassaa koyro xaafettida xeelluwaa bessettida wodiyan bessees. Baynna gallassati bessettokkona. Ha xeelluwati laamettaa ubbaa xaafokkona woykko gallassaa wurssettaa qoodaa bessokkona. Erettibeenna qoodati zoppa gidokkona. Gallassaa xeelluwataas ha bagaa Export oosuwaa go'etta; toolbar-a Export oosoy sprint-a ayfiyaa kessees.
scrum-scope-history: Oosuwa giddonne attida oosuwa, laamettiyoobaa issuwa issuwa
scrum-scope-history-help: Sprint doommido wodeppe doommiidi bookkiya taarikiyaappe zaari bessettees: sprint kaardetu, qoppettida qooduwa woykko polettida oosuwa laamettiyoobassi issi xuruuri.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Taarikee ha sprint huuphen naagettida hanotaa zaari shiishshana danddayenna: issi issi laamati taarikiyan xaafettibeenna. Hegaa gishshawu, ha qoodati kumetta gidokkona.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Koyro laamati xalaala nabbabettidosona; zaari bessiyoogee kumetta gidenna.
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: UTC gallassaa ubbaa koyro xaafettida xeelluwaa; baynna gallassati bessettokkona. Xeelluwati laamettaa ubbaa woykko gallassaa wurssettaa qoodaa xaafokkona. Erettibeenna qoodati zoppa gidokkona.
scrum-import-pending: Scrum gelissuway wurssettibeenna. Scrum laammiyoogeenne erissuwaa kessiyoogee baawa.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Zaari doommiyoogan eqqida gelissiyoogaa, i eqqidoogaappe guyyiyan, hagan polana danddayettees. A halchchoy muleera naagettibeenna gidikko, a xaissana xalaala danddayettees; hegee bookkiyan aybbaakka laammenna.
scrum-import-into-board-hint: WeKan bookkiyaa kessuwaa woykko Scrum sirssiyo fayliyaa doora. Ha bookkiyan kase de'iya sprint-tinne kessuwati gattettoosona, naa'u toho medhettokkona. Kaardiyati ID-n, woykko kaardiyaa qoodaaninne sunttan gaittettoosona; gaittonna kaardiyati xaafettidi laamettokkona. Aybee laamettiyaakko be'anaw koyro sinttan xeella.

sync-conflict-hint: Palamaa ubbaas wagaa doora. Sync dooruwaa ubbaappe guyye zaarada paaccees. Yiyo sistemiyaa aybikka kiitettenna.

sync-conflict-review-complete: Neessi immettida kaardiyati xeellettidosona. Saaxinetuwaa palamay attibeenna. Kumetta mazgabaa Sync oottibeenna.
sync-conflict-detach: Naa'antto koppiyaa ha sohuwaa kaardiyaa gidi naaga
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Ha naa'antto koppiyaa Sync gattaa xalaala digga. A giddon de'iyaagee WeKan-n attees.
sync-conflict-archive: Oottiya guutta kaardiyata gaasuwan naago sohuwaa efiyoogee diggettiis
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Yiyo sohuwaa miishshay baawa, shin oottiya guutta kaardiyati naago sohuwaa efiyoogaa diggoosona. A Sync gattaa diggada ha kaardiyaa ha sohuwan naaga. Guutta kaardiyati laamettokkona.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Kase kaardiyaa laammennan naagada ha mazgabaa giddon ooratha Sync kaardiyaa medha. Zaarada paacciyoogee laammettiyaagaa go'ettees.
sync-preview-saved: Naagettida giigissuwaa bolla. Sync ha'i yiyo sohuwaa zaarada ehhidi paaccees.
sync-preview-unavailable: Koyro xeelluwaa oychchanaappe kase Sync yiyo sohuwaa naaga.
sync-preview-blocked: Laamettaa halchchuwaa xeellanaappe kase garssan de'iya palamaa birshsha.
sync-preview-scope: Qoodati giigissettida yiyo sohuwaa saaxinetuwaa yootoosona. Gujjiya daatay yiyo sohuwaa nabbabiyaagan aggettana danddayees.
sync-source-heading: Sohuwaara koppe oottettibeenna yiyo sohuwaa saaxinetuwaa
sync-source-scope: Ogeti yiyo sohuwaa miishshata giddon saaxinetuwaa be'ettiyoogaa shiishshoosona. Gattettibeenna miishshati kumettan yootettoosona; eta wagati bessettokkona.
sync-source-truncated: Erissuway ogiyaa 100nne guuxxettida saaxinetuwaa sunttan gaggettiis.
sync-source-omitted: Bessettida ogiyaappe kare de'iya gujjiya be'ettiyoogaa
sync-report-partial: Dhayida woykko wurssettibeenna oottuwati issi issi kaardiyata laamminaa gidana danddayees. Ha erissuwati oottuwaa zaarada doommokkona woykko guyye simmissokkona.
sync-report-unavailable: Oottuwaa erissuwaas kumetta mazgabaa xaafiyo maatanne oottiya serveriyay koshshees.
sync-recovery-description: Wurssetta gallassaa 30 giddon naagettida Sync erissuwata. Bookkiya woykko mazgabaa ID-n koya. Wurssettibeenna ayfiyay ha'ikka oottettana woykko eqqana danddayees. Zaarada paaccanaw ooraxxa; ha erissuwati laamettaa zaarada doommana woykko guyye simmissana danddayokkona.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Sync paaccuwaa nabbabana dandda'ibeenna. Alaafiyaa gelluwaanne serveriyay de'iyoogaa paacca.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Gattettida Jira gelissuway medhido mala, Jira saaxiniyaa ID-nne qoodaa mazanaa de'iya qoodaa saaxiniyaa doora. Ha sohuwaa laamettati palamaa gidi xeellettoosona. Baynna yiyo sohuwaa wagati aattettoosona; qonccidi xaafettida null gattettida wagaa geeshshees.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: GitLab deexoy woykko wodiya qoppettida qooday neeni doorido qooduwa sa'an xaafettees. Hagan laamettidaabay ittippe giigennaabadana paacettees; deexoy bainna oosoy gidikko, oykettida qooday quccettees.
email-recovery-description: Issi ekkiyaagau issi xuruuraa. Go'ettiyaagaa ID-n koya. Kiitatu giddo de7iyaabaynne ekkiyaagaa iimeeliyaa sohota bessiyaagee qoncce gidettenna. Guutta wodiyaayyo essiyoogee ha77i de7iya kiitatanne guyyeppe yiyaagaa naagissees; zaaridi doommiyaagee naagiya kiitata ha77i yeddanau paaccees. Aggiyoogee oychchida wodiyaagakkanau mazgaban gelida kiitata xayssees. Yeddiyoogee oosettishe de7ikko, guutta wodiyaappe guyyiyan zaaridi paacca. Yedettishe de7iya kiitaa guyyekko zaaranau danddayettenna; gakkidoogee geeshshi erettibeenna kiitay naa77u gede yedettana danddayees. Ubba wode ixxida yeddiyoogeenne paaciyo qoodaa wursida kiitati qorettanaayyo naagettosona. Yedettibeenna kiitata zaaridi yeddanau paaciyoogee ooratta paaciyaa doomissees; kase de7iya guutta wodiyaayyo essiyoogaa naagees.
email-recovery-empty: Naagiya kiitati woikko yeddiyoogee guutta wodiyaayyo eqqida ekkiyaageeti baawa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Iimeeliyaa mazgabaa nabbabanau danddayettibeenna. Ayssiyaagaa maatanne serveree de7iyoogaa qoretta.
email-recovery-busy: Yeddiyoogee woikko mazgabaa hara oosoy oosettishe de7ees. Ooraxissada guutta wodiyaappe guyyiyan zaaridi paacca.
email-recovery-failed: Oosoy polettidoogaa geeshshi eranau danddayettibeenna. Mazgabaa ooraxissa; koshshikko he oosuwaa zaaridi paacca.
email-recovery-superseded: Oosanchchaa ooratta oosoy ha oychchaa laammiis. Mazgabaa ha77i hanotay beettees.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Ha ekkiyaagau ha77i naagiya kiitata ubbaa agganee? Eta giddo de7iyaabay xayana; zaaridi ehanau danddayettenna. Ha oychchaappe guyyiyan medhettida ooratta kiitati naagettana.
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kiitettidoogee ammanettana dandda'ibeenna; zaarada paaccanaappe kase xeella
sync-time-estimate-hint: Wodiyaa qoodati Jira gelissuway medhida koyro/attida wodiyaa qoodaa saaxinetuwaa go'ettoosona. Ha bookkiyan gaittiya saaxiniyay issi xalaala de'ana bessees. Ha sohuwaa laamettati palamaa gidi xeellettoosona; baynna yiyo sohuwaa wagati aattettoosona qassi qonccidi xaafettida null wagaa geeshshees.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint-tinne kessuwati ha bookkiyan Scrum oottiyo wode xalaala issippe oottettoosona. Baynna sprint woykko kessuwaa yiyo sohuway immiya gallassataara ha bookkiyan medhettees; de'iyaagee koyro yiyo sohuwaa ID-n, yaatin sunttan gaittettees. Ha sohuwaa halchchuwaa laamettay yiyo sohuway he oyshaa halchchuwaa laammana gakkanaw attees, qassi koyro Sync halchchuwaa mule diggenna.
activity-recovery-description: Wurssettibeenna erissuwati bena zaarada paacettoosona. Zaarada paaccanaappe kase baynna woykko laamettida oosota xeella. Zaarada paacciyoogee oosuwaa mule zaarada medhenna.
activity-recovery-busy: Hara oosanchchay ha erissuwaa oottees. Ooraxxada zaarada paacca.
activity-recovery-denied: Ekkiyaagaa gelluway woykko erissuwaa dooruway kiittiyoogaa ha'i maatenna.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Koyro oosoy baawa woykko laamettiis. Aybikka zaarada medhettibeenna.
activity-recovery-failed: Erissuwaa kiittiyoogaa wurssana dandda'ibeenna. Naagiya oosoy naagettiis.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Ha erissuway dumbbettidoogaappe guyye laamettiis. Zaarada paaccanaappe kase ooraxxettida hanotaa xeella.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Kiittiyo giigissuwaa ammanana dandda'ibeenna. Ooraxxada ha'i de'iya hanotaa xeella.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Ha oosuwaas attida kiittiyoogaa merinaa aggane? Hagee zaarada doommettenna. Kase maaran wottettida email-anne kiitettida erissuwati zaarettokkona.
rule-email-recovery-description: Wogatu iimeeliyaa yeddanau xaafettida paacetaa be'a. Geeshshi erettibeenna paacee ha'i gakkanaassi yeddishin de'ana danddayees, woikko gidduwan teqettidaagaa gidana danddayees. Ha odoy zaaridi yeddenna; yeddiyoogaakka teqqenna.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Ha koyuwaara gaggayiya wogatu iimeeliyaa yeddanau paaci baawa.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Seeraa email paaccuwata dumbbana dandda'ibeenna. Zaarada paaccanaw ooraxxa.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan geeshshi erettibeenna iimeeliyaa ba huuphen zaaridi mulekka yeddenna. Zaaridi yeddiyoogee geeshshi erettibeenna ekkiyaageetuyyo xalaala. Gakkidoogaa erikko, yedettidaagaa mala malaata wotta; woikko agga.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Koyro yeddiyoogee ha77ikka oosettishe de7ana danddayees. __time__-ppe guyyiyan qachchana danddayaasa.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Ha iimeeliyaa geeshshi erettibeenna ekkiyaageetuyyo zaaridi yeddanee? Iimeeliyaa serveree WeKan erissennan ekkido asati naa77u gede ekkana.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Ha iimeeliyaa ubba asaayyo yedettidaagaa mala malaata wottanee? Gakkidoogaa erikko xalaala hegaa ootta.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Ha iimeeliyaa agganee? Geeshshi erettibeenna ekkiyaageetuyyo yedettenna.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Koyro yeddiyoogee ha77ikka oosettishe de7ana danddayees. Guyyeppe zaaridi paacca.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kase zaaridi yeddiyoogee ha77ikka oosettishe de7ana danddayees. Guyyeppe zaaridi paacca.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Ekkiyaageeti ubbati kase geeshshi erettidosona. Yedettidaagaa mala malaata wotta.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Iimeeliyaa serveree zaaribeenna. Zaaridi yedettidaagee gakkana woikko gakkennan attana danddayees; oosettishe de7iyaagaa mala beettees.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Haraa ayssiyaagee ha iimeeliyaa metuwaa birshshees. Guutta wodiyaappe guyyiyan zaaridi paacca.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Naagettida iimeeliyaa ha paaciyaara ha77i gaittenna; hegaa gishshau hagan metuwaa birshshanau danddayettenna.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Ha paaciyaa naagettida xaafettidaagee likke gidenna; hegaa gishshau hagan metuwaa birshshanau danddayettenna.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Ha iimeeliyaa metuwaa birshshanau danddayettibeenna. Ooraxissada zaaridi paacca.
rule-email-legacy-description: Ha seeratu iimeeleti kase WeKan qommon giigidosona; shin eta giddo de7iyaabay awappe yiidaakkonne xaafettibeenna. Hegaa gishshau WeKan ba huuphen eta yeddenna. Seeraa medhdhidaagee ha77ikka kaardiyaa gelana maataa de7iyoogaa qorada, ha77i kaardiyan de7iyaabaappe zaaridi giigissanau iimeeliyaa zaarada qashsha; woikko agga.
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Ha iimeeliyaa ha77i kaardiyan de7iyaabaappe zaaridi giigissanee? A giddo de7iyaabay kase giigidaabaappe dumma gidana danddayees.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Qorettanaagaa naagiya seeratu iimeeleta ehanau danddayettibeenna. Zaaridi paaccanau ooraxissa.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Seeraa medhdhidaagee ha kaardiyaa gelana maataa ha77i baawa, woikko seeray laamettiis. Hegaa gishshau zaaridi qashshanau danddayettenna. Aggana danddayaasa.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Ha iimeeliyaa doommissida oosoy laamettiis; hegaa gishshau zaaridi qashshanau danddayettenna. Aggana danddayaasa.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ha iimeeliyaa yiido kaardiy ha77i baawa; hegaa gishshau zaaridi qashshanau danddayettenna. Aggana danddayaasa.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ha iimeeliyaa giigissida seeraa oosoy ha77i naagetti de7enna; hegaa gishshau zaaridi qashshanau danddayettenna. Aggana danddayaasa.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Ha iimeeliyaa kase yedettiis, yeddanau paacettiis, woikko agettiis.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ha oosuwaa polanau danddayettibeenna. Ooraxissada zaaridi paacca.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Zaarada oottettana danddayonna List Sync oosota
stuck-sync-operation-description: Naagettida ha List Sync oosoti ubbay giddon eqqidi ha'i wurssettana danddayokkona, aissi giikko a mazgabay diggettiis, zaarada medhettiis woykko zaarada giigettiis, woykko a doommida oosanchchay xaafiyo maataa dhayssiis. Issoy naagiyo wode, he mazgabay Sync oottana danddayenna. Mazgabay zaarada Sync oottana mala yegga: kase oottettida laamettati attoosona, attida naagettida laamettati mule xaafettokkona, qassi kaalliya Sync mazgabaa a yiyo sohuwaara zaarada geeddarssees.

stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: A doommida oosanchchay kumetta mazgabaa xaafiyo maataa ha'i baawa
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: A doommidoogaa baynnan kase WeKan versioniyan naagettiis
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Oonee a doommidaakko yootiya xaafay baawa
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Hagee ha'i zaarada oottettidi ba huuphiyan wurssettana danddayees, hiza yeggettana danddayenna.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Naagettida ha List Sync oosuwaa yeggane? A kase oottida laamettati attoosona; attidaageeti mule xaafettokkona. Yaatin mazgabay zaarada Sync oottana danddayees.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Xeelluwaa naagiya List Sync oosoy baawa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ubbaappe beni 50 xalaala bessettoosona. Daroba be'anaw issi issuwaa yeggada ooraxxa.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: List Sync oosota dumbbana dandda'ibeenna. Zaarada paaccanaw ooraxxa.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Ha oosoy eqqidaagaa gidi demettibeenna, hiza yeggettana danddayenna.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Ha oosoy ha'i zaarada oottettidi ba huuphiyan wurssettana danddayees, hiza yeggettibeenna.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Ha mazgabay ha'i Sync oottees. Guutta wodiyaappe guyye zaarada paacca.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ha oosuwaa polanau danddayettibeenna. Ooraxissada zaaridi paacca.
interrupted-import-description: Ha bookkiyaa gelissuwati ubbay giddon eqqidosona - serveriyay zaarada doommiis, woykko gelissuway dhayiis - qassi bagaa bookkiyaa aggidosona. Gelissuway aadhdhana danddayenna, aissi giikko a yiyo fayliyay naagettenna. Bookkiyaa de'iyo mala naaga, woykko yeggada fayliyaa zaarada gelissa. Yeggiyoogee ha gelissuway medhida bookkiyaanne a bolla de'iyaabaa ubbaa, guyyeppe gujjettidaagaa gujjada, diggees.
interrupted-import-scrum: A Scrum deriyay ba huuphe checkpoint de'ees (__state__, __total__ deriyaappe __next__). Bookkiyaa naagiyaakko, bookkiyaa Scrum gelissuwaa zaaruwaappe wurssa woykko yegga.
interrupted-import-counts: ogeta __swimlanes__, mazgabata __lists__, kaardiyata __cards__, paacciya mazgabata __checklists__, qofata __comments__, gattidobata __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Ha bagaa bookkiyaa de'iyo mala naagane? Aybikka diggettenna, qassi gelissuway hagaan ha'i xaafettenna.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Ha gelissuwaa yeggane? A medhida bookkiyaynne a bolla de'iyaabay ubbay merinaa diggettees.
interrupted-import-empty: Xeelluwaa naagiya eqqida bookkiyaa gelissuway baawa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ubbaappe beni 50 xalaala bessettoosona. Daroba be'anaw issi issuwaa naagada woykko yeggada ooraxxa.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Eqqida bookkiyaa gelissuwata dumbbana dandda'ibeenna. Zaarada paaccanaw ooraxxa.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ha id de'iya bookkiyaa ha gelissuway medhibeenna, hiza bochchettibeenna.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: A Scrum deriyay ha'ikka xaafettees woykko zaarettees. Guutta daqiiqaappe guyye zaarada paacca.
interrupted-import-failed: Ha oosuwaa polanau danddayettibeenna. Ooraxissada zaaridi paacca.

history-request-pending-redo: Serveriy ne wursetta zaari oosuwaa ha77i gakkanaas tuma gididayssa erisibeenna.
history-request-hint: Zaari paacciyo wode he oychchaa xalaalaa zaari kiittees; hessa gishshau nam77antto laamettidobaa muleka zaaranaw danddayenna.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Scrum laamettaa guyye simmissiyoogee, zaarada oottiyoogee woykko zaariyoogee palaman eqqiis. Ha bookkiyan Scrum laammiyoogee a birshshettana gakkanaw diggettiis.

scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Guyye simmissiyoogee laamettida xaafay ubbaa kase de'iyo mala zaarees; he xaafata guyyeppe hara asay laammibeennaba xalaala immettees. Bookkiyaa de'iyo mala naagiyoogee eqqida oosuwaa diggees qassi ay xaafaakka laammenna. Waanna gidikkokka, Admin Panel, Problems, Recovery giddon xaafettees.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Eqqida oosoy kase xaafida laamettaa gujjada, xaafay ubbaa ha'i de'iyo mala naagane?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Bookkiya alaafiyaa a guyye simmissana woykko bookkiyaa de'iyo mala naagana danddayees.
login-setting-after-restart: WeKan zaari doommidoogaappe guye oothanaw doommees
login-setting-env-only: Hayssata serveriyaa heeraa xalaala wottees. Hagaan nabbabanaw xalaala bessettoosona.

email-to-card-webhook: Iimeeliyaa immiyaageeta geliya webhook URL (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark woykko MIME kiittiyaa)
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Ha grain kiittido iimeeliyaa biya bookkiyaa
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Baawa - huuphe yohuwaa giddo bookkiyaa tookiniyaa de'iya iimeeliyaa xalaala
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Ha bookkiyaa nena ne huuphiyan gakkanaadan hayssa huuphe yohuwaa giddo wotta:
email-to-card-address-private: Geeman naaga: hegaa de'iya ooninne nena gidada kaardiyaa gujjana danddayees.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Iimeeliyaa ekkiyoogaa Alaafiyaa sohuwaa giddo giigettibeenna.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Bookkiyaa haariyaagee ha bookkiyaa iimeeliyaa doyibeenna.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Neeni ne bookkiyaa teesuwaa Yaraata giigissuwaa giddo cuqqiyaadasa.

email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ha bookkiyaa bolla xaafiyo maataa koshshees.
inbound-account-invalid: IMAP iimeeliyaa saaxinaa loohiya seerveriyaa sunttaa koyees.
feature-views-email-desc: Bookkiyaa iimeeliyaa saaxinaadan: iimeeliyaa mazgabay gelliyaa saaxinaa, mazgabati kifiliyaa, malaatati malaatata, qassi yaraati bookkiyaa teesuwaappe iimeeliyaa xaafoosonne zaaroosona.
email-view-not-receiving: Ha bookkiyaa iimeeliyaa ha gakkanaw ekkenna. Bookkiyaa Erissuwaa giigissuwan → Iimeeliyaa kaardiyaa oottiyoogaa doyya.
email-view-invalid-address: Teesuwaappe issoy loohu iimeeliyaa teesuwaa gidenna.
email-view-too-many: Wurssetta saatiyan daro iimeeliyaa kiittettis. Guyyeppe zaarettada malla.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bookkiyaa haasayaa oosuwaa sohuwaadan: oosuwaa sohoti, bookkiyaa, ogiyaa, mazgabatanne kaardiyaa kanaaleta mittadan, kaardiyaa giddon qassi a qofati haasayaa kiitaadan.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Issi kaardiyaa sunttay de'iya daro kolomiya shiiquwan - wurssiyaaninne, kase oottanabaaninne, malaataaninne woy hara baan - gochchiyan kolomiyaa giddon sirssettees.

feature-board-summary-desc: Menu → Qaaxxay asi ubbay wurssetta gallassaa woykko saaminttaa kaameta bolli ay oottidaakko qassi ay wodee aadhdhidaakko bessees.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu → Ne wurssetta xomoosaappe doomettidi harati bolli ay laammidaakko bessees.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ubbaa koyiyoogee "ta wodee aadhdhida kaardeta" giyaagaa mala qaalata akeekees.
column-sets-empty: Kolomiya shiiqoy biraasheka baawa. Bookkiyaa alaafiyay issuwaa medhdhanaw danddayees: sunttaa immada, simmin kolomiyaa gujja.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bookkiyaa GitHub woy Gitea metuwaa kaalliyaagaadan: kaardiyaa metuwaadan, malaatatanne gita malaatata, qofata haasayaadan, gattidobata faayiletadan, qassi bookkiyaa taarikiyaa simmiyoogaara.

vcs-no-list: Ha bookkiyan metuwaassi mazgabaykka ogiyakka baawa.
card-qr-code-desc: Ha kaardiyaa silkkiyan woy tableetiyan dooyanaw iya scan oottite.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ha kaardiyaa gattiyay QR koodiyaassi keehi adussees.
vcs-no-wiki: Wiki hanna gakanaw baawa. GitHub dirijjitiyaa gelissiyoogee wiki haa ehees.
github-org-import-desc: Dirijjitiyaa woy goettiyaa naaga sohuwaa ubbay ba huuphe boordiyaa gidees, Board View / Version Control giddon dooyettidoogaa: a metuwaa qofatanne malaatatanne faylatanne, a kessidobata, a GitHub Actions oosuwaa Seeratada, a wikiyaanne.
github-org-import-token-hint: Xaala sohuwaasinne API wolqqaa dariyaagaas koshshees. Gelissiyoogee oottettiyo wode xalaala goettettees; mule naagettenna.
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Dirijjitiyaa woy goettiyaa sunttaa, woy a GitHub teessuwaa xaafa.
optional-apis-desc: Hara kaallidaa (tracker) API mala REST API, eta appeti nne script ati ha WeKan backend oothidi goettanaadan: eti naagiyaabay WeKan giddon, WeKan bookkiyaa bolla naagettees. Issoy issoy hagaani malaatettanaashin teqettidaagaa. Issoykka ba maataa baawa: client WeKan API token-n gelees, qassi he asay WeKan giddon beˈanaanne laammanaa danddayiyaabaa xalla beˈananne laammanaa danddayees. Ubbaykka WeKan REST API doyettanaadan koyees (WITH_API=true). Issoy issoy garsaa de'iya teesoy client ba server oothidi goettiyaabaa.
optional-api-trello-desc: Trello REST API-w xaafettida appeti nne script (leemisuwaa Trellinator) WeKan-ra oottoosona: bookkiyaa, mazgabaa, kaardiyaa, malaatata, yaraata, qofata nne paaciyaa mazgabata. Trello token-ay WeKan API token. Kaardiyaa shiishiyoogee WeKan giddon naago sohuwaa efees.
optional-api-jira-desc: Jira REST API v2 client-ati WeKan-ra oottoosona: projektiyaa bookkiya (a qulfiyaa bookkiyaa qulfiya), metoy kaardiya (DEV-7), haalay mazgabaa, qassi laamettay kaardiyaa shiishshees. Koyiyoogee shiimpiya JQL ekkees: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text nne ORDER BY. WeKan API token-iyaa paasewurdiyaa oothidi gela. Metuwaa shiishiyoogee naago sohuwaa efees.
optional-api-github-desc: Metuwaa GitHub REST API client-ati WeKan-ra oottoosona: repository bookkiya, metoy kaardiya, malaatatara, gita malaatatara (wurssiyo gallassay de'iya malaatata), qofatara, qassi Bookkiya xeelluwaa / Versiyuwaa haariyoogaa giddon de'iyaagaadan dooyettidoogaa woykko gorddettidoogaa. Token-ay WeKan API token.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Metuwaa Gitea nne Forgejo REST API client-ati GitHub-ra maayettiya API mala WeKan-ra oottoosona: repository bookkiya qassi metoy kaardiya. Token-ay WeKan API token.
bots-none: Ha77i bootoy baawa. Bootoy ne server bolla oosuwaa oottiya - AI wolqqiya, CI oosuwaa, script - ha bookkiyay kaardiyaa immiyaagaa.
bot-option-not-found: He zaaroy bootoy immido zaaruwaa gidenna.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Kare kiittiya Webhookati WeKan ba netiwoorkiyaa bolla de'iya teesuwaa gakkenna, ays giikko oonikka bookkiyaa webhook giddo oosuwaa baggaa zaaranaadan. Webhookati gakkana danda'iya he netiwoorkiyaa hostata hagan xaafa - Node-RED, chat serverey - issi xuuriyan issuwaa, sunttana woykko teesuwana, he portiyaa xalaala eeyyanaadan portiyaara. Mela: aykkoka baawa. Saytiyaa alaafeti xalaala ha dizhaa laammana danda'oosona.
account-webhook-desc: Issi asi gelikko woy ooratha akkawuntiyay medhettikko WeKan yootiya issi sohuwaa. Garssan deiya hanay malaatettanaashin aykkoka kiitettenna. Hanaa, oosanchchaa sunttaanne wodiyaa ehees; ekkiyaageessi koyikko xalaala harabaa sohuwaa malaatissa.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Ay gallassaappe kasetiya oosuwaa naagiya ubba erissuwaa aggana?
vcs-synced-from: %sppe issuwaa oottido: yan dooya qassi gordda.
vcs-synced-issue: Ha metuwaa issuwaa oottido: ba kaalliyaa bolli dooya qassi gordda.
sync-write-back: Laamettaa GitLab-iyo zaarettada xaafa: huuphe sunttaa, qonccissuwaa, qofaa, gorddanaw qassi zaarettada dooyanaw
email-bounces-description: WeKan simmido iimeeliyaa ay oottiyaakko: balettidi xaafettida sohuwaa, kumida iimeeliyaa saaxiniyaa, bitta baynnaa zaaruwaa, spamee zilppaa. Ubba qaxxay ba oosuwaa de'ees, he taymaa simmido wode oosettees.
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Sohoy baawa: xaafiyo balay, xayssettida akaawuntiya, erettenna domeyinee.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ha'i gakkibeenna: saaxiniyaa kumiis, sarveree oosuwan de'ees. Darotoo issippe simmiko xalla birshshettees.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Bitta baynnaa, shempporaa woykko tikeete sirattaa zaaruwaa. Iimeeliyay gakkiis.
email-bounces-ses-description: Amazon SES giddon, Bounce nne Complaint erissuwaa, WeKan kiittiyo sohuwaas ekkiyo wogaa SNS huu7e yohuwaa kiitta, qassi ha sohuwaa HTTPS baggaara hegaa xaafa:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ekkana SNS huu7e yohuwaa ARN, issi xuufen issuwaa
email-bounces-stopped-only: WeKan zaari iimeeliyaa kiittenna sohuwaa xalla
email-bounces-clear-hint: Ha sohuwaa simmidoyaa dogada qassi zaarada iimeeliyaa kiitta
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Hagee SNS huu7e yohuwaa ARN gidenna.
email-bounces-providers-description: WeKan ha oosuwaappe issuwan kiittiyaaba gidikko, a dooya, oosuwaas simmido iimeeliyaa nne spamee zilppaa hanotaas ha webhook sohuwaa immaa, qassi a malaatiyo qulfiyaa, woy https://user:password@… woy ?secret=… gidi sohuwan wottido geeman qaalaa haan wottaa
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Doyettida oosuwaas ba malaatiya qulfiyaa woy geeman qaalaa koshshees.
activity-pub-enabled: Asa ubbaassi bookkiyay ba kaardiyaa oosuwaa fediverse bolli qonccissees (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Koyro de'iyoogaadan tooqettidaagaa. Doyettiyo wode, asa ubbaassi bookkiyaa ubbaa Mastodon nne hara fediverse sarverepeppe @board-<id> giidi ha WeKan adraashan kaallana danddayettees, qassi ooratta kaardiyaa oosoy kaalliyaageeta gakkees. Nabbabanawu xalla: fediverse sarvereppe kiitettiyabay oonikka bookkiyaa laammenna, qassi huuphe bookkiyay mulekka qonccissettenna.
caldav-sync-desc: Ha bookkiyaa kaardiyaa wurssetta gallassaa wodiyaa qoodaa giddo wotta - Nextcloud Calendar woykko CalDAV wodiyaa qoodaa ay gidinkka. Wodiyaa qoodaa giddon sirssettida wurssetta gallassay kaardiyaakko simmees. Ne geeman qaalaa gidennan, aappe geeman qaalaa go'etta.
caldav-enabled: Wurssetta gallassaa ha wodiyaa qoodaara issippeessa
caldav-invalid-url: Wodiyaa qoodaa adraashay http:// woykko https:// adraasha gidanawu koshshees, giddon go'ettiyaagaa sunthay woykko geeman qaalay baynnaada.
caldav-not-linked: Koyro wodiyaa qoodaa adraashaa naaga, qassi issippeessuwaa doya.
webdav-storage-description: Gattidobata WebDAV sarvere bolli de'iya fooldariyaa giddo naaga - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud woykko hara ay gidinkka. WeKan-ssi oottida aappe geeman qaalaa go'etta. WeKan bau neetworke bolli de'iya sarvere hagan go'ettana danddayettees, ays giikko ha adraashaa saytiyaa alaafiyaa xalaali wottees.
sqrl-desc: Koyro wodiyaa qolpettidaagaa. Doyettiyo wode, gelo maxaafaa SQRL immees, qassi miishshaa asati koyro bantta SQRL eraxaa Miishshaa giigissuwan gujjoosona. SQRL WeKan https:// teeqo bessiyaa sohuwan koyees.
sqrl-scan: Ne SQRL oosuwaa ehaa koodiyaa xeella, woy ha miishshaa bolli ne SQRL oosuwaa doya.
sqrl-expired: Ha SQRL koodiyaa wodee wuriis. Zaariidda doma.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL WeKan https:// teeqo bessiyaa sohuwan koyees.
sqrl-description: Geeman qaalaa gisho ne SQRL eraxaa ehaa gela. Ne SQRL oosuwaa ehaa haaninne issitoo gujja; ne koyiyo wode haappe digganaw dandda'aasa.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: SQRL ehaa gelay ha akaawuntiyaas ne SQRL oosuwaappe qolpettiis. Yan ne ashshiyo koodiyaa ehaa zaarada doya.
sqrl-only-on: Ne SQRL oosuwaa ha akaawuntiyaa SQRL xalaalan qolpiis: geliyo hara ogee ubbay ixettees.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Ne SQRL oosuwaa ha akaawuntiyaa minttidi qolpiis: geeman qaalaa ooratissiyoogaa iimeeliyaa laammiyoogaa ixettees.
sqrl-hardlock: Ha akaawuntiyaa SQRL bolla qolpettiis: hara ogiyan zaaridi demmanaw woykko laammanaw dandda'ettenna.
windows-sso-failed: Windows ehaa geliyoogee danddayibeenna. Ne Windows akkawunttay haan eriyettenna aggana danddayees.
